title: Separate Ways
subtitle: Here, "farewell" means "fate will bring us together again."

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Shush! Someone's here. Get in my sleeve.
Paper Heron gives the mule's rump a light slap. It brays as it ambles behind a nearby haystack.
She presses close to the wall and peers out at the two men. One familiar, the other unfamiliar and bearing greater authority.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Commander Lì.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Such hurried words, Chéng. What's the matter?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: It's concerning an unusual parade that has been seen moving through the town. The marchers chanted strange words and even tempted townsfolk to join their ranks.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But they vanished as soon as our men arrived. This is the fourth such incident in as many weeks.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Go on.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Sometimes they leave animal carcasses in their wake. I've ordered a search. Our men may discover something soon.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: These animals are unusual. They bear no marks of either hunting or natural death. It appears to be some sort of ritual slaughter.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: They're the ones that have been spreading those rumors about the Method of Longevity. Many townsfolk have joined with them. I fear ...

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: You would have me redirect men that already stretched thin to chase down a parade.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Which, so far, has done little more than leave a few dead animals behind. Do I understand you correctly?
Chéng Héguāng's face turns red. He wants to say something, but the words come out in a fluster.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: All of these events are linked together with the Stilted Parade, and—

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng, what are the orders I've given you?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: To maintain order, keep criminals from the county, and to see our people enjoy the fair in safety.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: And how do you judge your performance?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I have done my utmost, Commander.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Yet there was a disturbance at the gate.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I cannot deny it.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: The Stilted Parade is the most significant event of the year, an opportunity for people to laugh and be merry after a year of hard work.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: It's our duty to maintain peace so that they may enjoy the festival.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: But with all the visitors flooding into the county, we are already short on men.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: You know well that they have been working day and night. Many haven't seen their own homes in days.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I know, Commander.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: No, you do not. While your men are out dealing with these visitors and all their other duties—

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: You come to ask that I direct them to another task based on groundless suspicions?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: My apologies, Commander.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: *sigh* Raise your head. Listen. You are pushing yourself too hard, Héguāng.
Noticing his protégé's dejected silence, the stern commander softens his tone, if only ever-so-slightly.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: I know how eager you are to prove yourself. Any man in your position would be.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: And I know it was I who told you to work ten or a hundred times harder to earn your place, given your father's history.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: But true diligence must rest in stability. There are no shortcuts.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Many eyes are on you, Héguāng. If you truly wish to wash your family name of its dishonor, let them find no fault in you.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Do your duty first, then take the next step. That is how things are done.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I understand.
He keeps his face pointed down, averting his commander's stare. Lì Huìfēng thinks for a moment and clears his throat.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Ahem. Your father disgraced himself when he threw his lot in with those bandits, but that does not mean you will follow his path.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: You must not let the whispers of others shake your heart.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Do you remember why I recruited you? Because I saw a young man with the integrity and conviction to truly protect people.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: I still do.
Lì Huìfēng pats the young officer on the shoulder, then returns his hands stiffly behind his back.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: Héguāng, your future is bright. Work hard, and you will surely rise to the top, and your family name will be cleared.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Understood.

items.speaker: Li Huifeng
items.text: I have other matters to attend to. Think carefully on my words.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I will, Commander.
Watching from the wall, Paper Heron sees the young man standing motionless. For a moment, he seems so stiff that he could be a wood carving.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: The other one's left. What's he waiting for, hm?
Suddenly, Chéng Héguāng lifts his foot and kicks a pebble away.

items.speaker: Mule
items.text: Whinny?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Who's there?

items.speaker: Mule
items.text: Whinny?
Meeting the sound with calm and precise motion, he summons a hundred leaves that circle the mule; in that same instant, they take on a fearsome steel glint.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Uh-oh!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You go ahead, Mayfly. I can't leave that stupid mule behind.
She picks up Mayfly's paper form with her left hand. With her right, she makes a gesture to break the incantation, then breathes a soft puff of air that sends her floating away.
Paper Heron watches as her friend drifts out of reach before leaping to the top of a nearby elm and hiding among the leaves.
Now only one man and one mule remain.

items.speaker: Mule
items.text: Bray—

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hmph. That Daoist must be around.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: But her trail ends here. Where did she go?
Chéng Héguāng looks around. He feigns an attack on the mule but stops mid-gesture as he catches a ripple of air from the elm tree above him.
In a flash, Paper Heron stands amidst a newly formed ring of elm-leaf blades.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You won't get away!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Oops! Should've been more careful.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Huff, huff. You surely can run, officer.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: *panting*

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Why were you eavesdropping, you conniving Daoist?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: You must be mistaken, sir. I merely happened to be there.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You happened to be there, did you? After making a scene at the gate this morning? Do you think me born yesterday?

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Ugh, is there any worth in explaining? You're being unreasonable.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You can explain in the interrogation room!
Paper Heron jumps onto the roof and seizes a straight, even branch, blocking an attack from behind.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Hey, hey, hey! Your blade's sharp! I might have been hurt!

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hmph. My blade is no threat to you! If you have nothing to hide, stop this now and follow me to the Yamen!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Very well, on one condition.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: What?
At that, Paper Heron's eyes light up as she launches into an eager explanation.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: My mule's been limping since it twisted its ankle in the mountain.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Could you teach it how to run? I think with a little training, you could make a champion out of it.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Panicked Voice
items.text: Chief! Chief!

items.speaker: Yang Wu
items.text: There's another disturbance at the gate! Come, quickly!

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Oh?
Chéng Héguāng looks over in surprise to find Yáng Wǔ standing in the street, scratching his head, and then back to Paper Heron, who has stopped a short distance away.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Told you I'm not the one you should be chasing.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: The gate again! Your accomplices, no doubt!
He surges forward on a burst of Qi in pursuit of Paper Heron. Yet, with unhurried ease, she drifts back, maintaining her distance precisely.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Enough!
Chéng Héguāng spins his blade, and all the leaves on the tree become sharp edges.
A humming noise fills the air as the sharp leaves pin Paper Heron against the wall.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Huh?

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: I can't let another disturbance reach Commander Lì.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: You stay here. I will take you and your accomplices to the Yamen on my return.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Not to worry, officer. I'll stay right where I am.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Take my mule if you mistrust me. You know I won't leave it behind.
Paper Heron nods toward the limping mule below. He looks down to it. As if waiting for that cue, the mule brays out a greeting.
He looks back to Paper Heron, pinned yet completely serene. He snorts, sheaths his blade, and jumps down from the roof.

items.speaker: Cheng Heguang
items.text: Hmph. There's no time to waste.
In a quiet corner of the street, Mayfly stands on her tiptoes, peering around.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Hey, Mayfly.
Finding no one, she darts forward still on her tiptoes.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Are you alright? I played a trick at the gate to distract him.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Much appreciated.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: *blow*

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Wow! You blew those off like dust.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: It's not as hard as you imagine.
Paper Heron stretches while Mayfly watches the leaf blades fall in a clatter. A hint of envy shines in her eyes.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I knew you'd work things out. Your mastery of arcanum is truly amazing, even if you lose your way sometimes.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I wish I could be like you.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Wandering the world, fighting and casting spells, saving my friends from danger ...

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Nonsense! You just saved me from the clutches of the constables, didn't you? Our lives shine equally bright.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Ah, but I know what you mean. You want to learn some of my tricks, eh? I can teach you.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *sigh* No, that's not what I mean. Besides, there isn't time.
With a shake of her head, Mayfly swallows the words. They would have been pointless.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Actually, Heron, I must say farewell.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Farewell? Why?

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Well, I'd planned this even before we entered town. Would've gone sooner if not for being caught.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: But where will you go? I thought you were seeking the Method of Longevity.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: I'm not leaving, just off to find some other herbaceous Yao. You know, plants of a leaf, same belief.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: I understand.
She nods, but there's a strange tug of emotion within it.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *sigh* But I worry for you already. For all your wonderful abilities, you're just so careless.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Don't you worry about me. I'll be fine. Haven't met any rotten folk in this town thus far.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: Let me see. There's you, that gullible constable, the cake seller, and the Yao from the parade. Well, I saw through their tricks. You see, I can take care of myself.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Heh. You make it sound like a tale for the ages.
She wants to say more, but at the sight of Paper Heron's calm composure, she stops herself.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Right. This is it then. Farewell.

items.speaker: Paper Heron
items.text: As it must be, farewell.
Giving a wave goodbye, Paper Heron turns back with a whistle, and her mule trots behind her.
In the sunset, their shadows stretch long and thin. Paper Heron stops on the road, takes some paper and a brush from her mule's pack. Before long, a slip of paper drifts into the wind behind her.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: *sigh* I can't tell if she's a fool or a genius.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hmm? What's this in my pocket?
She reaches into her pocket to find an object she doesn't remember putting there.
It's the same amulet she had trampled, now restored, and beside it, a hastily written note:

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: Hold the amulet and chant, "Hide my body behind Zhēnwǔ and my soul in Tongming Palace," then pinch your left thumb and middle finger. That will deceive the Reversion Bell. No cultivation needed.

items.speaker: Mayfly
items.text: W-When did she ...?
The warm orange light of sunset bathes Zhu County. Against the busy evening traffic, Paper Heron leads her mule, her back to Mayfly as she waves once again.
